description:
Returns today's connections in the reader's reading: passages from different books they are reading, and from their saved quotes and notes, that share a theme, with the theme named and a question to reflect on. The first call each day creates them: ReadingRate sends a few of those passages to its AI provider to name the theme and write the question, then stores the result in the reader's account and counts it against their ReadingRate AI usage. Later calls the same day return the same connections.

Use when the reader asks what connects their recent reading, or for today's reading connections or reflection prompt.
name: get_daily_reading_connections

message.description: Why there is nothing today, when there is not

reflection_prompt.description: A question for the reader to reflect on

title: Get today's reading connections
